头选「一个头几张脸」：只有一个头、一根脖子，多出来的脸朝着两边和后面（阿修罗的三: With "1 head, N faces", there is only one head and one neck, and the extra faces point to the sides and to the back (Asura's three faces). With legs set to "Auto", 4 legs make a centaur lower body, 6 or more make an arachne (spider body), and an odd number goes "Side by side". Centaur and arachne legs only come in pairs, so an odd number gets one extra leg. "Humantaur" is like a centaur, but behind the body there is no horse body: instead there is a sideways section of human waist, followed by another human pelvis and legs. With "Humantaur" and "Tandem" (one pelvis behind the other), each pelvis can carry several legs side by side (for example, 6 legs with 3 per pelvis is "three front, three back"); if the total doesn't divide evenly, the last pelvis gets fewer. "Gather at pelvis" works like "Gathered at shoulders" for arms: several pelvises sit tightly one against the next, each with one pair of legs, and the legs spread outward more and more toward the bottom, so from the front it looks like a fan, while the pelvis as a whole stays as wide as one person's. When the number of human legs is odd, the extra leg sits on the center line: in the middle for "Side by side", and in the middle of the last pelvis for "Tandem" and "Gather at pelvis". Hands set to "Separate fingers" stick together in the preview and only come apart after export.

身高、头身比按标准人形算；多排手臂、人马、蛛形会更高，以顶上的读数为准。: The "Height" and "Heads tall" sliders assume a standard humanoid; extra rows of arms and centaur or arachne bodies make the figure taller, so go by the readout at the top.

每只脚原地落到地面、脚掌放平，腿跟着弯；有腿够不着地面时整个人往下落。上半身不动: Each foot drops straight down to the ground with its sole flat, and the legs bend to match; if a leg can't reach the ground, the whole figure is lowered. The upper body doesn't move

在这一页里，导出和截图出来的是摆好的样子；切回「造型」导出的是静止姿势。姿势跟着: In this mode, exports and screenshots show the posed figure; switch back to "Shape" to export the rest pose. 点了姿势以后接着拖「强度」、改部位，刚点的那个姿势跟着重新套；拖了圆点、撤销过以: After clicking a pose, keep dragging "Strength" or changing the parts, and the pose you just clicked is re-applied to match. Once you have dragged a handle or undone something, further changes only affect the next pose you click (to change the strength for the next pose only: change it, then press Undo once).
显示地面的影子和参照圈: Show the ground shadow and reference ring
「透视」越大，近大远小越夸张（像广角镜头）；越小越平（像长焦）。这一栏只影响屏幕: The larger "FOV" is, the more exaggerated the effect of near things looking big and far things small (like a wide-angle lens); the smaller, the flatter (like a telephoto lens). This section only affects how things look on screen and in screenshots, not the exported model.
盖在模型上面（半透明，比轮廓用）: Overlay on top of the model (semi-transparent, for comparing outlines)
把自己画的正面、侧面设定图垫在模型后面，对着它调体型。正面图从「正面」「背面」看: Put your own front and side design sheets behind the model and adjust the body shape against them. A front image is visible from "Front" and "Back"; a side image is visible from "Left" and "Right" (a character drawn facing left looks correct from "Left"; if it faces right, click "Flip horizontally"). They fade out when you rotate to an angled view. "Size" is how tall the figure in the drawing is (blank margins removed); when you pick an image, it is aligned to the current height with its feet on the ground. Lowering "Perspective" to 10°–15° makes the comparison more accurate. Images are stored in this browser only; they are not included in the config file, the undo history, screenshots, or exports.
所有设定自动存在这个浏览器里，下次打开还在。「保存配置」另存成一个文件，换电脑或: All settings are saved automatically in this browser and will still be there next time. "Save config" saves them as a separate file, for moving to another computer or keeping a backup.

给 VTuber 软件（VSeeFace、Warudo…）、VRoid Hub、: For VTuber software (VSeeFace, Warudo…), VRoid Hub, Unity, and Blender's VRM add-on. The rest pose is a T-pose (as the VRM spec requires), and the pose you set is not saved in the file. VRM only recognizes one head, one pair of arms, and one pair of legs; the extras stay attached to the skeleton and will not be moved by the software.

好几个上半身时，头、手臂、胸、角、眼睛、兽耳可以每个上半身单独设。左右是角色自己: With several upper bodies, heads, arms, breasts, horns, eyes and animal ears can be set for each upper body separately. Left and right are the character's own: seen from the front, her left is on the right of the screen
一键换软硬：几根、排法、大小、微调都照旧，软的小一圈、往前下方垂: Switch between hard and soft in one click: count, layout, size and tweaks stay the same; soft is a little smaller and hangs forward and down
选「一起动」以后，拖哪一对手臂，别的几对就照它摆（左右各算各的）；同一个上半身上: With “Together”, whichever arm pair you drag, the other pairs copy it (left and right separately); arms on the same torso stay staggered and spread as before
好几个上半身时，每个上半身可以换成别的角色（比如一个男生、一个女生）；胯和腿照上: With several upper bodies, each one can be a different character (say, a boy and a girl); hips and legs follow the character picked above. Left and right are the character's own: seen from the front, her left is on the right of the screen
连拇指一共几根。多出来的是照无名指复制的，排在无名指和小指之间；少了先拿掉无名指: Total number of fingers, including the thumb. Extra fingers are copies of the ring finger, placed between the ring finger and the little finger. With fewer fingers, the ring finger is removed first, then the middle finger.
二次元素体的脚才有脚趾。多出来的是照第二趾复制的，排在第二趾后面；少了先拿掉第四: Only the anime base body has toes. Extra toes are copies of the second toe, placed right after it. With fewer toes, the fourth toe is removed first, then the third and the second. The heel and ankle stay the same; only the front of the foot gets wider or narrower.
手臂末端接手还是脚: Whether the arms end in hands or feet
腿末端接脚还是手: Whether the legs end in feet or hands
手脚互换：手臂末端接一只脚。手臂垂下来时脚底朝下、脚趾朝前，像腿上那样，缩到和手: Hand–foot swap: the arms end in a foot. With the arm hanging down, the sole faces down and the toes point forward, like on a leg. The foot is scaled to the thickness of the wrist.
手脚互换：腿末端接一只手。手心朝下贴地、手指朝前，像倒立时撑地的手，放大到和脚踝: Hand–foot swap: the legs end in a hand. The palm rests flat on the ground with the fingers forward, like a hand in a handstand, scaled up to the thickness of the ankle. A hand is shorter than a foot, so the whole body sits a little lower. Animal legs on centaur and spider bodies don't change.
只改这一条：末端接手还是脚。「跟着全部」就是照「造型 → 排布」里统一的那一项: Changes only this limb: whether it ends in a hand or a foot. "Same as all" follows the shared setting under Shape → Layout.
这一条手臂或腿末端接什么: What this arm or leg ends in
两个上半身在腰上对接的连体形式: Conjoined form with two upper bodies joined at the waist
queen conjoined：两个上半身在腰上对接，连成一条横着的身子，四条手: Queen conjoined: two upper bodies joined at the waist into one horizontal body standing on four arms, with no hips or legs. "Same direction" has both chests facing down; "opposite" has the other one lying face-up with its arms reaching back to the ground. When chosen, legs, tails, penises and multiple upper bodies are ignored.
连体静止时的姿态：趴着是四只手撑地；侧躺是两个上半身侧着躺在同一条轴上，靠地那只: Resting posture of the conjoined body. Prone: standing on all four hands. On side: both upper bodies lie on their sides along one line, the lower arm reaching forward along the ground and the upper hand propped in front of the chest. Flat: lying flat on the back with the arms resting at the sides (in "opposite", the other one lies face-down). Standing: the lower one does a handstand on both hands while the upper one stands normally.
连体静止时是趴着、侧躺、平躺还是站着: Whether the conjoined body rests prone, on its side, flat or standing
点中手、脚、胯以后，出来的是沿前后、左右、上下挪的箭头，还是旋转环。电脑上按 W: After you pick a hand, foot or hip, show arrows that move it forward/back, left/right and up/down, or the rotation ring. On a computer, W and E switch too.
